explanation: Template specialization allows programmers to define custom implementations of class or function templates for specific types or conditions. This feature is used to optimize or modify behavior for particular data types, enabling more efficient or tailored code while maintaining generic programming capabilities. It is a core aspect of C++ template metaprogramming, facilitating compile-time customization and type-specific optimizations.
keywords: Template Specialization, Class Specialization, C++ specialization, Type-specific template
